# FloatingActionButton

## FloatingActionButton

A raised icon button, optionally extended with a label, for a screen's
primary action.

### Decisions

- **Neutral and reference values are Superloom decisions.** The roster flags
  this row `superloom_decision`: the retired second reference's FAB answered
  the contract's `fab_*` cells directly, while the neutral and reference
  templates map the reference's action scale onto the same cells (census S).
  The reference's own answer to the primary screen action is
  BottomToolbarPrimaryAction, a separate component (M9), so the row records
  no reference-template twin.

### Not carried

- `lowered`: upstream draws a flat variant, but the contract has no flat
  cells; adding them would invent tokens.
- `disabled`: the reference system draws no disabled FAB state; a screen's
  primary action either exists or doesn't.
- `hidden`/`visible`: upstream's visibility animation has no cells.

### Accessibility

`role="button"`. The label names the extended form; a bare icon button
requires `accessibilityLabel` and the component throws a `TypeError`
without one.

## FloatingActionButton

FloatingActionButton is a raised icon button, optionally extended with a label, for a screen's primary action; its Carbon twin is BottomToolbarPrimaryAction, so its values outside the Material template are a Superloom decision.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@material/web`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | `superloom_decision` - anatomy or a value decided here, not measured from a reference |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | `string` | yes | Semantic icon name from the theme's icon set; it draws the button's glyph. |
| `label` | `string` | no | The extended form's text. With a label the button is always the medium size. |
| `kind` | `string` | no | One of `kinds`: `surface`, `primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`. Default `surface`. |
| `size` | `string` | no | One of `variants`: `sm`, `md`, `lg`. Default `md`. Ignored with a label. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `string` | no | Accessible name; required when there is no label. |
| `onPress` | `function` | no | Called when the button activates. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the button. |

| Metric | Rule |
